svg.text: The panel knows which view and which selection the
user is on. Opening it suspends nothing.
Clearing is deliberate. One conversation runs for the
session and nothing clears it on the user's behalf.
Applying runs the user's own operation, so whatever that
operation discloses is disclosed here: what a deletion will
take, the answers an archiving offers, and any part of the
The proposals stay outstanding and nothing is written.
The answer arrives on its own. The advisor is slower
than the rest of the product and stays non-blocking while
Each approved proposal is then written completely.
There is one advisor and one conversation per session.
The conversation is journaled and stays out of version
Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
A proposal that takes nothing has nothing to disclose.
One that deletes or archives discloses exactly what the
user's own gesture would, because it is that gesture.
One request dismisses a single proposal and a whole
answer alike. Already-resolved proposals are skipped.
Applied and dismissed proposals are closed already and
The whole funnel goes with the question: themes, ideas,
goals, routines, focus history, tasks and progress
A proposal is a structured object, never prose to be
parsed. At most one proposal is outstanding per target,
and an already-applied or already-dismissed one is
One request applies a single proposal and a whole
answer alike. There is no second write path: a proposal
to create something carries everything that thing needs.
